records.author_body: I review early-stage products as a first-time user, and I keep seeing the same pattern: people sign up, but most never reach the product's first useful moment. Before I write about it, I want to hear from founders who are living it: • How many people signed up in your first few weeks, and how many did something meaningful? • Where do you think they got stuck? • What have you tried so far? Rough numbers are fine. I'm not selling anything, and I'll share a summary of what I learn. If you're open to a 15-minute chat or a longer message exchange, reply here or DM me.
